scheme_name: HDFC Small Cap Fund - Direct Growth
exit_load: 1.0% if redeemed within 1 year; Nil thereafter
tax_treatment: Equity taxation: Long-term capital gains (LTCG) above ₹1.25 Lakh taxed at 12.5%. Short-term capital gains (STCG) taxed at 20%.
statement_download_process: Download statements and capital gains tax reports via the official HDFC MF Online portal (hdfcfund.com) or CAMS/MFCentral using PAN and Folio.
